info.name: Dentex API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for the Dentex dental-school clinical management backend (Laravel).

Covers Auth, Receptionist, Student (courses, cart, marketplace, appointments, diagnoses, treatments), Instructor (diagnosis review, treatment review), Head of Department (case type / delegation / statistics management), and Store Owner (products, promotions, orders).

Setup:
1. Set `base_url` (defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000/api).
2. Run the relevant Register + Login requests in 'Auth & Profile' for each role, then paste the returned token into the matching *_token collection variable (student_token, instructor_token, receptionist_token, hod_token, store_owner_token).
3. Each folder's Authorization tab is pre-wired to the matching token variable, so every request inside it just works once the variable is set.

item.name: Auth & Profile

academic_year must be 4 or 5. Used by the registration screen to populate the group dropdown for students.
Activates the account after registration using the 6-digit OTP code emailed to the user.
All fields are optional (sometimes|required). Only send the fields you want to change.

item.description: Public authentication endpoints plus session/profile endpoints usable by any authenticated role. Register & Login require no token; the rest use the student_token by default (swap the Authorization tab token as needed for other roles).
